data: 120 fictional researchers, 720 fictional works, 132 queries; labels derived from fixture topics
evaluation: Unseen topic-pair intents; paraphrases stay together. Transductive fixed-catalog ranking, not new-author generalization.
limitations: Synthetic labels are not human relevance judgments
Default TF-IDF/SVD is lexical latent retrieval, not Sentence Transformers
No employment history, availability, contact details or protected-attribute inference
Ranking score is not a confidence or compatibility probability
